$comment: The Android permissions a Pocket Arcade app may hold (spec N3: only AdMob and Google Play Billing go online). check-store-aab fails any other uses-permission of a store AAB; android-emulator-build keeps the same list for the APK check. Each entry names who declares it. To be confirmed against the first real merged manifest (Android step 5); a new entry is a reviewed change with its source.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.source: AdMob and Play Billing (the only network users, N3)

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.source: AdMob, UMP and WorkManager (pulled in by AdMob)

permissions.name: com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID
permissions.source: AdMob's advertising id (the expo-tracking-transparency plugin adds it too)

permissions.name: <package>.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
permissions.source: androidx.core, declared for the app's own package
